name: gitattributes-check
description: Which git attributes apply to a file (line endings, binary, Git LFS, export-ignore, GitHub linguist), and which .gitattributes line decides. Same answer as git check-attr.
long_description: check_attributes tells, for each path, every attribute git applies and the file and line that decides it, plus what it means in practice: line-ending conversion, binary diffs, Git LFS storage, files left out of release archives, GitHub language stats. Exact git rules: last match wins per attribute, macros ([attr], built-in binary), set / -unset / !unspecified / value, nested .gitattributes files, .git/info/attributes, quoted patterns, and the trap that a dir/ rule never applies to the files inside. explain_gitattributes explains each line and flags the classic mistakes. Port of git's own attr.c and wildmatch.c, checked against git check-attr on about 77,000 random cases. Offline, read-only. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).
